concept: IAM: role via instance profile instead of access keys on EC2
tests: How to give an app on EC2 access to the S3 API without storing long-term credentials on the instance.
expected: Attach an IAM role via an instance profile — temporary, automatically rotated credentials through the instance metadata service. Triggers: "forbids storing long-term credentials", "EC2 needs to call AWS API".
why_not: Access keys in user data or env vars are long-lived secrets on the host; root credentials — never.
